purpose: Reset inherited 2x texture scale on new prison tokens and their actors
script: const s=game.scenes.get("3L7PArmd7RTkC8vp"); const toks=s.tokens.filter(t=>t.flags?.["pentaryn-prompts"]?.provenance && (t.texture.scaleX!==1||t.texture.scaleY!==1)); const fixed=[]; for (const t of toks){ await t.update({"texture.scaleX":1,"texture.scaleY":1},{animate:false}); const a=t.actor; if(a && !t.actorLink && a.prototypeToken.texture.scaleX!==1){} if(a){ const base=game.actors.get(t.actorId); if(base) await base.update({"prototypeToken.texture.scaleX":1,"prototypeToken.texture.scaleY":1,"prototypeToken.ring.subject.scale":1}); } fixed.push(t.name);} const left=s.tokens.filter(t=>t.flags?.["pentaryn-prompts"]?.provenance && t.texture.scaleX!==1).length; return {fixed,left};

purpose: Rewrite connector A destinations as full Region UUID strings and verify they resolve
script: const A=game.scenes.get("3L7PArmd7RTkC8vp"), B=game.scenes.get("qKZWFtGa3xeZXxWL"); const a=A.regions.find(r=>r.name.startsWith("Connector A")), b=B.regions.find(r=>r.name.startsWith("Connector A")); const ua=["Scene",A.id,"Region",a.id].join("."), ub=["Scene",B.id,"Region",b.id].join("."); await a.behaviors.contents[0].update({"system.destinations":[ub]}); await b.behaviors.contents[0].update({"system.destinations":[ua]}); const ra=a.behaviors.contents[0]._source.system.destinations, rb=b.behaviors.contents[0]._source.system.destinations; return {ua, ub, aSrc:ra, bSrc:rb, aOK: fromUuidSync(String(ra[0]))?.id===b.id, bOK: fromUuidSync(String(rb[0]))?.id===a.id};

purpose: Find hooks that touch region behaviors (destination rewrite)
script: const names=Object.keys(Hooks.events).filter(k=>/RegionBehavior|Region/.test(k)); const out={}; for (const n of names) out[n]=Hooks.events[n].map(h=>(h.fn.name||"anon")+": "+String(h.fn).slice(0,160)); const f=foundry.data.regionBehaviors?.TeleportTokenRegionBehaviorType?.defineSchema?.().destinations; return {out, fieldClass: f?.constructor?.name, elem: f?.element?.constructor?.name, opts: f?.element?.options};

purpose: Resolve connector A relative destination uuids from their behaviors
script: const A=game.scenes.get("3L7PArmd7RTkC8vp"), B=game.scenes.get("qKZWFtGa3xeZXxWL"); const a=A.regions.find(r=>r.name.startsWith("Connector A")), b=B.regions.find(r=>r.name.startsWith("Connector A")); const ba=a.behaviors.contents[0], bb=b.behaviors.contents[0]; const ra=fromUuidSync([...ba.system.destinations][0],{relative:ba}), rb=fromUuidSync([...bb.system.destinations][0],{relative:bb}); return {aTo: ra?.uuid, aOK: ra?.id===b.id, bTo: rb?.uuid, bOK: rb?.id===a.id};

script: const map=await fetch("/pentaryn-prompts-specs/artmap.json").then(r=>r.json()); const s=game.scenes.get("qKZWFtGa3xeZXxWL"); const toks=s.tokens.filter(t=>t.flags?.["pentaryn-prompts"]?.provenance?.call==="pm-ac4e" || t.flags?.["pentaryn-prompts"]?.provenance); const upd=toks.map(t=>({_id:t.id, displayName:30, "texture.scaleX":1, "texture.scaleY":1})); await s.updateEmbeddedDocuments("Token",upd,{animate:false}); const miss=[]; for (const t of toks){ const a=game.actors.get(t.actorId); if(!a) continue; const subj=(t.ring?.subject?.texture||"").split("/").pop(); const raw=map[subj]; const u={"prototypeToken.displayName":30,"prototypeToken.texture.scaleX":1,"prototypeToken.texture.scaleY":1}; if(raw) u.img=raw; else miss.push(t.name); await a.update(u);} const levels={}; toks.forEach(t=>{levels[t.level]=(levels[t.level]||0)+1}); return {count:toks.length, levels, noArt:miss, scaleLeft:s.tokens.filter(t=>t.flags?.["pentaryn-prompts"]?.provenance && t.texture.scaleX!==1).length};
